'''Axebot''' is a normal {{2|Monsters|Enemy}} found in {{2|Glory}}.

== Pattern ==
{{Intents Table/start|Axebot}}
{{Intents Table/row
| Name   = Boot Up
| Intent = Defend, Buff
| Effect = Gains (10;{{Asc2|8|15}}) {{KW2|Block}} and (3/6;{{Asc2|9|4/8}}) {{BD2|Strength}}.
| GivesToEnemy = Strength, Block
}}
{{Intents Table/row
| Name   = The One-Two
| Intent = Attack2
| Effect = Deals (10;{{Asc2|9|11}}) damage 2 times.
}}
{{Intents Table/row
| Name   = Hammer Uppercut
| Intent = Attack2, Debuff
| Effect = Deals (14;{{Asc2|9|18}}) damage. Applies 2 {{BD2|Weak}} and 2 {{BD2|Frail}}.
| GivesToPlayer = Weak, Frail
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
The Axebot always cycles {{Int2|Axebot|Hammer Uppercut}} then{{Int2|Axebot|The One-Two}} then repeat.

The Axebots spawned mid-fight via {{BD2|Stock}} opens with {{Int2|Axebot|Boot Up}} before entering the cycle. The second spawned Axebot uses the improved version of {{Int2|Axebot|Boot Up}}. Every time a new Axebot is spawned it gains +10 Max HP more than the last one (So the first respawn has 10 HP more, the second 20 HP more etc.).

== Interactions ==
=== Synergies ===
* {{BD2|Stock}} provides successive opportunities to activate {{KW2|Fatal}} triggers with {{C2|Hand of Greed}}.
** {{C2|Feed}} and {{C2|The Hunt}} both {{KW2|Exhaust}} when played, but they can be played multiple times per combat when {{KW2|Enchant|Enchanted}} with {{KW2|Soul's Power}} from the {{E2|Grave of the Forgotten}} event.

== Notes ==
* If a multi-hit Attack that doesn't target a single enemy (such as {{C2|Sword Boomerang}} or {{C2|Dagger Spray}}) kills an Axebot with {{BD2|Stock}} partway through the attack, the new Axebot will be summoned in the middle of the attack, and it can be hit by that same Attack.
** This does ''not'' occur for multi-hit Attacks that only hit a single enemy, like {{C2|Twin Strike}}.
* If an Attack that hits all enemies and applies a debuff (such as {{C2|Thunderclap}} or {{C2|High Five}}) kills an Axebot with {{BD2|Stock}}, the new Axebot will be summoned in the middle of the attack, before the debuff is applied. The new Axebot will then be inflicted with the debuff.
* When an Axebot with {{BD2|Stock}} dies during the enemy turn, such as by {{BD2|Poison}} or {{BD2|Thorns}}, the summoned Axebot will not do anything that turn, and it will use {{Int2|Axebot|Boot Up}} on the following turn.
